signal: Lyric raised a $43.5M Series B for supply chain decision AI, grew revenue 500%, and is rallying its ecosystem around Empower Chicago 2026 with Estee Lauder, Krispy Kreme and Kuehne+Nagel

email.subject1: a signal play for Lyric's ecosystem
email.body1:
Jon, saw Lyric raise its $43.5M Series B and rally the ecosystem around Empower Chicago with names like Estee Lauder and Kuehne+Nagel.

An expanding partner ecosystem usually means more co-sell targets than the team can cover, and partner-sourced pipeline stalls when nobody works the long tail. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across that ecosystem autonomously, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Lyric's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jon, quick follow-up for Lyric.

Most alliances leaders can't cover every co-sell motion across a fast-growing ecosystem, so partner-sourced pipeline shows up thin and late. Multi-channel sequencing run by the worker generates 287 percent more responses than single channel.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook scoped to Lyric's top partner targets, and where coverage breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jon, last bit of proof for Lyric.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lyric's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jon, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Building an ecosystem around a flagship event is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your alliances motion? I'll tailor it to Lyric either way.
